title: Lee as a child blackface comic
summary: He describes his blackface costume and makeup as a small boy in minstrel shows and carnivals.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: You mentioned briefly, sort of in passing, that you were a blackface comic --this was in connection with what? The minstrel shows?
Uh huh, and the carnivals. Yeah. My sister has a picture someplace; as a matter of fact, my son has a picture. I must have been around that tall.

Maybe. And I was a black -- my face was black and I had a big bow tie; the bow tie was larger than I was; it was made out of paper -- it was like pink paper or something, and I had on a white sailor's cap, and
a little black coat. I don't know ... my son has a picture. He's kind of in to those things. I don't want to see them; I can't imagine anyone being a blackface comedian, you know.
And I told jokes, too. I used to ... yeah.
Do you remember any of the jokes?
Oh no, that was just all slapstick comedy, you know.
